en.question: Can I buy new and used cars from China for Central Asian markets?
en.answer: Yes. We provide new car, selected used car, EV, SUV, sedan and fleet sourcing according to available stock.

en.question: Which Central Asian countries do you support?
en.answer: We accept inquiries for Central Asia and coordinate China-side sourcing, export documents and shipping support.

en.question: Can I get an FOB price by WhatsApp?
en.answer: Yes. Send the model, year, quantity, destination country and port, condition requirement and preferred fuel type so we can prepare a stock-based FOB quotation.

en.question: What documents are usually prepared for vehicle export?
en.answer: We coordinate China-side vehicle information, export documents, customs preparation and shipping documents according to the confirmed order and route.

en.question: Do you support Russian-speaking buyers?
en.answer: Yes. A Russian-language version of this page is available for Russian-speaking buyers.
